title: 超写实3D漫画肖像
prompt: Hyper-realistic 3D caricature of [NAME], featuring an expressive, oversized head, a short body, and a detailed, energetic facial expression. Wearing [OUTFIT / SIGNATURE LOOK], striking a [POSE / ACTION]. Studio lighting, cartoonish proportions, Pixar-style 3D rendering, ultra-detailed fabric and skin textures. The body is slightly smaller than the head. 1080x1080 square format.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作超写实 3D 漫画肖像，适合品牌形象设计、社交媒体头像和个性化礼物，带来皮克斯风格的生动细节与夸张头部表情。
